camel_example: aliyun cdn ModifyRealtimeLogDelivery --region cn-hangzhou --Project testProject --Logstore TestLog --Region 'ch-shanghai' --Domain 'example.com'
description_en: Updates real-time log delivery for a specific domain name. Each domain name supports only one Logstore
description_zh: 调用ModifyRealtimeLogDelivery更改域名实时日志投递，一个域名仅支持投递单个Logstore
kebab_example: aliyun cdn modify-realtime-log-delivery --project testProject --logstore TestLog --biz-region ch-shanghai --domain example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyRealtimeLogDelivery

parameters.help_en: The name of the Log Service project that is used for real-time log delivery
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The name of the Logstore where log entries are stored
parameters.name: logstore

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Log Service project is deployed. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144883.html
parameters.help_zh: 实时投递sls的地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144883.html
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name for which you want to update real-time log delivery. Only one domain name is supported
parameters.help_zh: 修改实时日志投递的域名，仅支持修改单个
parameters.name: domain
